executive.heading: Executive Summary
takeaways: Monthly costs: $3,000-18,000 MXN depending on school type
School year runs August to July
expatInfo: Best options: Colegio Terranova (IB), Colegio Motolinía
Spanish immersion support at most bilingual schools
Start enrollment process 2-3 months before school year

overview.heading: Education in San Luis Potosí
overview.intro: San Luis Potosí offers a robust educational ecosystem with options ranging from traditional Mexican public schools to prestigious international institutions. As a growing economic hub with major automotive (BMW, GM) and aerospace industries, the city has developed quality educational infrastructure to serve both local and expatriate families.
benefits: Lower cost than Mexico City (30-50% savings)
Access to major universities (UASLP, Tec de Monterrey)
